persistence_and_lifecycle.support_condition: compression >= 40 AND (activity >= 25 OR at least 1 core metric >= 1.20x)

context_specificity.applicability_guard: show only when activity_score >= 25 or at least one core metric >= 1.20x
context_specificity.role: descriptive context, not a hard spot gate and not a forecast

review_findings.support_compression_35: too permissive in reviewed cases; can continue episodes after compression has materially weakened
review_findings.support_compression_45_or_50: can discard meaningful continuation when activity remains strong around compression 40-45
review_findings.close_after_1: too reactive; can split meaningful continuation after one interrupted session
review_findings.close_after_3: too permissive; can carry stale evidence and merge distinct activity bursts
review_findings.established_3_of_5: over-promotes intermittent episodes; several candidates weaken immediately after reaching 3 supports
review_findings.established_5_of_5: too strict; rejects all sustained episodes in the current sample
review_findings.established_4_of_5: best semantic compromise in the reviewed sample, but remains empirically provisional

important_limitations: This is not a predictive-return optimization.
The sample covers one historical period and 27 eligible tickers.
Context peer groups are research groupings, not authoritative exchange classifications.
The support activity >=25 branch was empirically redundant in the current sample and remains a candidate simplification.
All thresholds require future out-of-period validation when API/data budget allows.
